item.title: Re: What more could I add? Something is missing.
item.content:encoded: That sounds like you'd benefit from passing the draft around the IRC chatrooms, then. The good people in #thecritters takes questions like that pretty regularly.

item.title: Re: What more could I add? Something is missing.
item.content:encoded: I already have a narrative fully planned out but I dont know if I've done enough or what else to do

item.title: Re: What more could I add? Something is missing.
item.content:encoded:
It might help to focus in on a singular narrative and have the information that gets revealed be tied into the momentum of that. We never learn the origins of SCP-3688 because its origins aren't important to the larger story about the Foundation reverse-engineering a kinetoglyph.

Do you have a similar story you're focusing on?

item.title: What more could I add? Something is missing.
item.content:encoded: In a draft I'm writing I have two medium and long length test logs that should efficiently tell the story of the SCP's origin. I'm probably going to write a journal for a civilian during the anomaly (it's an event anomaly) but I still feel like I am missing a lot of stuff. I can post the link to the sandbox if anyone wants.
